title: Hasaasa Qilleensaa
intro: Mee naannoo wanti hin mulʼannee fi wanti mulʼatu itti wal-xaxaa taʼe tokko yaadi, akkasumas fakkii wiirtuu mootummaa tokkoo isa kaan irraa adda taʼe tokko fuuldura dhaabbatta. Lubbuun kun beekumsa dhaqqabummaa idileetiin ala kan qabdu yoo ta’u, humnoota warri kaan tilmaamuun danda’amu ajaja. Taʼus, wanti humna guddaa qabu illee uumama xinnoo taʼeen gad of deebisuu kan dandaʼu siʼa taʼu, dhugaan hamma yeroo murtaaʼetti dhokatee turuu dandaʼa. Namni hambaan isaa baroota darbanii sagalee dhageessisaa jiru kun eenyu?
clues: Mootummaan ana booda namni tokkollee hin arganne naaf kenname.
Beekumsaa fi ogummaan warra jaallatamaa irraan dhaale.
Qilleensi ajaja koo jala ture, bakkan barbaadetti ajaja kootiin imalaa ture.
Dubbiin simbirroonni kun dubbatan hubachuu kanan dandaʼu siʼa taʼu, isaanis waraana koo keessatti tajaajilaniiru.
Waa'ee mootittii aduu waaqeffattu tokkoo oduun simbirroo xiqqoo tokko irraa argadhe.
Duuti koo hanga uumamni dachii tokko ulee koo nyaatutti dhokatee hafe, yeroo sana qofa jinniin waan hin mul’anne akka hin beekne hubatan.

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Duuti isaa hanga uleen isaa nyaatamutti jinnii jalaa dhokatee ture
outcome.answer: Duuti isaa hanga uleen isaa nyaatamutti jinnii jalaa dhokatee ture

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
